verification.method: Downloaded each immutable raw URL and verified byte equality with the local GPU-source cache. Recorded SHA-256, Git blob SHA-1 and byte length. No vendor source is redistributed in this manifest.

evidence.supports: Memstore uses eight host pages; four priority ringbuffer levels and two additional records are excluded from the context limit.
Context and ringbuffer addresses are record-stride offsets; the final context ID is reserved for the global context.
The device memstore record contains ten unsigned 32-bit fields; SOP is at byte 0 and EOP at byte 8, giving a 40-byte stride.
The device memstore is allocated once through the global allocator; APRIV devices request privileged memory and do not request GPU read-only permissions.
CPU timestamp observation reads the requested SOP or EOP word from the device memstore.
The gen7-9-1 device advertises APRIV, hardware fence and preemption capabilities; capability flags alone do not supply a working local hardware-fence owner.
GMU permissions and the selected GMU VA region derive from independent GMU flags.
Allocation lookup keys are memory kind plus GMU memory handle.
GPU flags select privilege, write permission and security; the GMU-only IPC_CORE path explicitly names the qcom,ipc-core DT resource.
MEMSTORE and HW_FENCE use existing device descriptors; optional GMU import uses that same backing instead of allocating ordinary replacement RAM.
Context registration passes record-specific SOP and EOP GPU addresses.
The global context uses its reserved record for SOP and EOP.
HFI defines IPC_CORE, MEMSTORE and HW_FENCE as distinct memory kinds; MEMSTORE stores context SOP/EOP while HW_FENCE owns Tx/Rx headers and queues.
GPU, GMU and host access/init flag bits have separate meanings; cacheability and secure requests are distinct flags.
Context allocation starts at ID 1 and excludes the reserved global context ID.

provider_policy.size_basis: Local provider choice of eight 4 KiB pages. The pinned vendor formula is eight host PAGE_SIZE pages; this manifest does not establish the vendor kernel PAGE_SIZE.
provider_policy.gmu_iova: 0x66000000 when GMU_ACC is requested; otherwise unmapped
provider_policy.gmu_permissions: Independent GMU_ACC, GMU_PRIV and GMU_WRITEABLE bits; no cacheable alias.
provider_policy.ownership: Independent pinned Normal NC singleton, no ordinary development-pool offset. Repeated compatible imports never clear live storage.
provider_policy.observation: Two ordered SOP/EOP observations. stable means equal samples only; completion_verified remains 0.

other_mmio.status: Not mapped: the fixed source path does not establish a board resource binding for these kinds. RAM is not a substitute for MMIO.

hardware_fence.status: Not mapped: requires a dedicated controller and preallocated Tx/Rx queues plus completion semantics; timestamp observation is not a hardware fence.

validation_limits: Source provenance and host software checks do not establish successful device translation, execution or coherency.
No new device run, SMC, RAW submission, production fence or Metal support is evidenced by this manifest.

implemented_ipc_core_evidence.status: Implemented as the fixed GMU-only IPC_CORE provider, gated by kernel host-client arbitration and a clean QMP handoff; retained until reboot. No CPU resource access or zeroing.
